message: Scaled 1 of 2 spindle speeds to 150 %; 1 left as a speed limit, 1 thread block to check by hand.

findings.message: S2500 is a spindle speed limit (G50), so it is not scaled.

This block runs at S180, which was scaled on line 8, and its code (G92) is a threading cycle on another kind of machine or in another G-code system: if this is a lathe program the thread is cut at the changed speed, so check the block by hand.
